root_cause: Parallel local fixtures wait only 100 x 10ms for the peer started file. The requested nonzero single-disk fault never starts when that fixture barrier expires; its absent v2-order file then masks the barrier failure. Delaying the peer 1.25 seconds reproduces this exact pre-fault refusal with old fixture. Increase only the bounded fixture handshake to 500 x 10ms; keep all durable/fault and branch-isolation assertions.
scope: No product, remote cluster, image, matrix PASS or published evidence changed by the aborted preflight.
